quests.definition: See (saw) describes the simple, often unplanned act of perceiving something with your eyes. Watch implies sustained, deliberate attention, which doesn't fit a bird that appeared and vanished quickly.
quests.explanation: See (saw) describes the simple, often unplanned act of perceiving something with your eyes. Watch implies sustained, deliberate attention, which doesn't fit a bird that appeared and vanished quickly.
quests.hint: This describes a brief, unintentional moment of visual perception, not focused attention.
quests.nuanceDifference: See (saw) describes the simple, often unplanned act of perceiving something with your eyes. Watch implies sustained, deliberate attention, which doesn't fit a bird that appeared and vanished quickly.
quests.usageExample: I SAW a strange bird in the garden this morning, but it flew away before I could get a photo.
quests.contextSentence: I SAW a strange bird in the garden this morning, but it flew away before I could get a photo.

quests.question: Stop what you're doing and _____ at this — you won't believe what just happened!
quests.prompt: Stop what you're doing and _____ at this — you won't believe what just happened!
quests.instruction: Select the word that best completes the sentence.
quests.definition: Look at is used to direct someone's attention deliberately to something specific, matching the command 'stop and look.' See describes passive perception and isn't normally used as a command with 'at' this way.
quests.explanation: Look at is used to direct someone's attention deliberately to something specific, matching the command 'stop and look.' See describes passive perception and isn't normally used as a command with 'at' this way.
quests.hint: The speaker is directing someone's attention toward a specific thing right now.
quests.nuanceDifference: Look at is used to direct someone's attention deliberately to something specific, matching the command 'stop and look.' See describes passive perception and isn't normally used as a command with 'at' this way.

quests.question: We stayed up late to _____ the entire season of the show in one night.
quests.prompt: We stayed up late to _____ the entire season of the show in one night.
quests.instruction: Select the word that best completes the sentence.
quests.definition: Watch fits because it describes sustained attention to something in motion, like a TV show over time. View is a close synonym but sounds too formal for casually describing a late-night binge with friends.
quests.explanation: Watch fits because it describes sustained attention to something in motion, like a TV show over time. View is a close synonym but sounds too formal for casually describing a late-night binge with friends.
quests.hint: Think about the sustained attention needed to follow a show over several episodes.
quests.nuanceDifference: Watch fits because it describes sustained attention to something in motion, like a TV show over time. View is a close synonym but sounds too formal for casually describing a late-night binge with friends.
quests.usageExample: We stayed up late to WATCH the entire season of the show in one night.
